_about: Version 85 sound effects: PixelLab create_sound_effect prompts. tools/v85_sfx_build.py notes how they were processed.

hit_1.prompt: a punch landing on a face, short punchy arcade beat em up hit, dry, no reverb

hit_2.prompt: a fist punching a face, slap and thump, short punchy arcade beat em up hit, dry, no reverb

hit_3.prompt: a quick jab punch hitting a body, meaty smack, 90s arcade beat em up, dry

heavy_1.prompt: a heavy kick landing hard on a body, deep thump with a crunch, 90s arcade beat em up, dry

heavy_2.prompt: a big finishing uppercut connecting, heavy bass impact with a crack, arcade fighting game, dry

swing_1.prompt: a quick fist whoosh through the air, short swish, no impact

swing_2.prompt: a fast kick swooshing through the air, short whoosh, no impact

fall_1.prompt: a man's body slamming onto a hard pavement, heavy thud, dry

fall_2.prompt: a person knocked down crashing onto a wooden floor, body thump and a little bounce

ko.prompt: knockout punch, huge deep boom impact with a crack, arcade beat em up KO hit, short tail

smash.prompt: a glass window smashing and shards falling on pavement

break.prompt: a wooden crate smashed apart, splintering cracking wood, debris clatter

ouch_1.prompt: a man grunting in pain when punched, short oof, British bloke, no words

ouch_2.prompt: a man getting winded by a punch to the stomach, short ugh grunt, no words

grab.prompt: grabbing someone by the collar, quick cloth rustle and a scuffle

throw.prompt: throwing a man through the air, effort heave and a big whoosh

land.prompt: trainers landing on concrete after a jump, light scuff thud

splash.prompt: something big falling into a lake, heavy splash of water

boom.prompt: short punchy explosion, boom with debris, video game

airhorn.prompt: UK garage rave airhorn, three short blasts

scratch.prompt: a DJ scratching a vinyl record back and forth, short scratch

clink.prompt: two pint glasses clinking together in a pub

dart.prompt: a dart thudding into a cork dartboard

thunk.prompt: a thrown bottle or object thunking hard against someone, hollow knock

whistle.prompt: a referee blowing a pea whistle, one sharp blast

special.prompt: fighting game super move, rising energy whoosh that ends in a big bass impact

engine.prompt: a small Italian moped scooter engine revving up

honk.prompt: an old small car horn honking twice, beep beep

bang.prompt: a single pistol gunshot, sharp crack

snore.prompt: a man snoring loudly, one long snore in and out, comedic

fire.prompt: flames bursting up with a whoosh and crackling

hiss.prompt: a spray can hissing for a moment
